mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_rules (id, code, name, description, source, days, threshold, time_window_minutes, value_threshold, compare_op, metric_type, metric_field, trigger_mode, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{source}, #{days}, #{threshold}, #{timeWindowMinutes}, #{valueThreshold}, #{compareOp}, #{metricType}, #{metricField}, #{triggerMode}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, source, days, threshold, time_window_minutes, value_threshold, compare_op, metric_type, metric_field, trigger_mode, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_rules WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, code, name, description, source, days, threshold, time_window_minutes, value_threshold, compare_op, metric_type, metric_field, trigger_mode, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_rules WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT id, code, name, description, source, days, threshold, time_window_minutes, value_threshold, compare_op, metric_type, metric_field, trigger_mode, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_rules ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC

SELECT id, code, name, description, source, days, threshold, time_window_minutes, value_threshold, compare_op, metric_type, metric_field, trigger_mode, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_rules WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
